text:
Nora L.: quick heads-up: i drafted a concise migration PR to harmonize examples to the action-response envelope and remove a pile of duplicated long examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123. need quick SDK sanity and link fixes.
Diego R.: thanks. which envelope did you pick as canonical? saw a few variants in older docs.
Nora L.: canonical: { action: \"string\", args: {...}, response: { status: \"ok|error\", payload: <nullable> } }. keeping examples minimal, and moving expanded cases to examples/expanded/ for discoverability.
Hannah S.: sounds good. can you paste the minimal JSON snippet you'll keep so i can confirm wording for the Go doc?
Nora L.: sure:
```json
{
  "action": "retrieve_order",
  "args": {"order_id": "ord_9"},
  "response": {"status": "not_found", "payload": null}
}
```
Diego R.: that makes sense. two notes: 1) add a one-line explanation that payload:null indicates no resource (not an error payload), 2) update JS snippets to use client.callAction where available.
Nora L.: good catches. i'll add the sentence and replace invoke->callAction in the JS snippets that are in the same repo.
sdk-bot: link-checker: detected 9 broken links in docs/guides/structured-output (CI job #1210).
Hannah S.: i'll triage anchors. we should prefer stable /spec/structured-output anchors and add short redirects on old pages rather than deleting them. keep searchability.
Diego R.: also flagging that the Hugo renderer strips leading spaces on fenced code blocks; removed indentation in the examples to avoid render bugs.
Nora L.: noted. one more thing: some Python snippets used client.invoke(...). i updated them to client.call_action(...) to match the SDK naming convention in the new SDKs, but left a backcompat note for older releases.
Hannah S.: please add a migration blurb under /guides/migration like: "Older SDKs may use invoke/tool_call; map invoke -> callAction (JS), call_action (py), and see examples/expanded/interop.md for language-specific mappings."
Nora L.: added that sentence. blockers before merge: markdown-lint clean, CI link-check green, and a quick review from @Diego R. on the Go mapping example.
Diego R.: will review in ~30m. if green i'll approve. also can add a tiny Go adapter showing how null payload maps to nil pointer.
sdk-bot: docs-build: preview available at https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-5123. link-checker: 0 failures after fixes.
Nora L.: merged 00 :tada: thanks all. follow-up: i'll schedule a short notes page capturing the checklist for future spec changes (lint, link-check, SDK grep, backcompat blurb, preview link).
